paragraphs: Bar Kapta and his two pupils lodged with Rav Yehudah, according to this entry (Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, folio 9). [At Berakhot 6:2:4, Rav Yehudah transmits the story of Bar Kappara and his two pupils lodging with an unnamed host.].
